summary: Constrain tests to traced requirements: every test cites the requirement it verifies, and behavior the spec leaves unspecified is explicitly marked out of scope instead of being locked in by incidental tests.

evidence.summary: GitHub Spec Kit: Specify->Plan->Tasks->Implement workflow; spec is the contract/source of truth for agent work; integrates 30+ agents as of 0.11.0 (2026-06).
2026 SDD guide: versioned structured specifications as source of truth; community reports 60-80% fewer rework cycles vs prompt-driven development.

not_for: characterization tests intentionally freezing legacy behavior

risks: Requires discipline when tests are mass-generated; lint for missing trace tags.
